reply_text:
I found one dated AI forecast from Nadella in 2023, and it is already in your recorded list. In his 2023 annual letter to shareholders he wrote that Microsoft "will make Microsoft 365 Copilot generally available to our commercial customers later this year." That matches `2023-10-nadella-m365-copilot-generally-available-this-year.toml`. I did not come across the Security Copilot claim (2023-07-25) on any page I opened.

**Pages I opened that had nothing new:**
- **The rest of the annual letter.** It says the "next generation of AI will reshape every software category and every business," but gives no date and isn't about AGI, so I left it out. The goal to "train and certify 10 million people by 2025" is a company skills-training target, not something AI will do, so it's out too.
- **NPR interview (December 2023).** His line "'23, I think, will be looked at as the year we started using AI" describes how 2023 will be remembered. It doesn't forecast anything AI will do, so I didn't count it.
- **Freakonomics Radio, Davos and CNBC.** The Freakonomics episode (June 2023) has no dated forecast in the part of the transcript I could read. The Davos press release (January 2023) and the CNBC Bing-launch article (February 2023) have none either. Both of those are news coverage, not his own words.
- **Wasted openings.** Microsoft's speeches index only showed 2026 transcripts on its first page, so I never got the 2023 keynote transcripts. I couldn't find the Wired interview at its original address, so I didn't open it.

**Things to check:**
- **Letter date.** The annual-report page I opened doesn't show a date. "October 19, 2023" comes only from a search snippet of a LinkedIn repost, so I gave the date as 2023-10. The letter's "just last month" fits Microsoft's September 21 Copilot announcement.
- **Search wording.** I removed the double quotes from one of the fixed queries when I ran it (`Satya Nadella 2023 AI by 20 OR next year OR within OR end of the decade`).
- **Not searched.** I used all 12 searches and all 6 page openings without reaching the Build 2023, Inspire or Ignite 2023 keynote transcripts, the Wired interview text or the 2023 earnings-call transcripts. Those are the most likely places for other 2023 claims.
